text.name: Aethermancer
text.lore: He learned young to let aether take the blows meant for his flesh. Now he draws on it for every battle, pushing his exhausted body beyond its limits. He knows what the power is costing him. He still believes he has the better bargain.
text.blurb: Uses mana to absorb damage. His talents can strengthen this protection, spend mana for added Cold damage or recover mana by dealing damage.
text.short: Regenerates an additional 2.5% of maximum Mana per second. 10% of damage taken is absorbed by Mana before Life.

text.name: Alchemist
text.lore: He came down here for the water. Something in the rock changes what is steeped in it, and he has tested it on everything, including his own blood. Years of experiments have left him sallow and half-poisoned. He still trusts his brews to carry him through the next fight.
text.blurb: A flask specialist whose talents grant combat bonuses during flask effects, improve recovery and replenish Charges.
text.short: Every 8 kills restore 1 Charge to each flask.

text.name: Rogue
text.lore: Obreth keeps his ties to the Obsidian Order quiet. They sent him into the depths to read the rock; he returned with two knives and has been trading up ever since. He has little patience for those who hide behind shields. Whatever the Order sent him to find, he keeps to himself.
text.blurb: The only character who can dual wield. His talents reward weapon pairings, strengthen opening hits and grant bonuses after kills.
text.short: Can equip a one-handed weapon in each hand.
says: Both hands may hold a one-handed weapon. A pair puts 75% of the main hand and 55% of the off hand into every hit, and the rate ALTERNATES: this swing at the main hand’s, the next at the off hand’s.

text.name: Warrior
text.lore: Mahthar seeks neither riches nor answers in the depths. The marks on his skin are older than these workings, and he cuts a new one after every worthy fight. He wears them openly in the warmth of the rock, trusting them more than any armour.
text.blurb: A weapon specialist with talents for shield defence, retaliation on Block and powerful two-handed attacks.
text.short: Hits can Stun enemies for 1.1s. The chance increases with the proportion of the target's maximum Life dealt as damage.

text.name: Ailment
text.means: What a DAMAGE TYPE leaves behind. Dealing a type applies its Ailment at that Ailment's own chance; past 100% you apply a second, past 200% a third. Resistance blunts one and Armour never does, which is what makes an Ailment the answer to something you cannot punch through.

text.name: Arc
text.means: A Projectile leaps from what it hits to the nearest enemy it has not, within 4.5 tiles. Each Arc is one more leap, for 70% of the damage.

text.name: Area of Effect
text.means: Widens every Burst and Cloud the skill makes, and reaches a Cone further. It grows the AREA, so a radius goes by the square root of it, and it never touches damage.

text.name: Armour
text.means: Blunts a HIT, by a share that curves with Armour points rather than with the size of the hit: 300 points is half the 75% cap. It does nothing at all against an Ailment.

text.name: Bleed
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Physical damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 5s. 22 damage a second, never scaled by Spell, Attack or Critical.

text.name: Block
text.means: A Blocked hit deals nothing at all — there is no second number. Block Chance caps at 60%, comes off a shield in your off hand and from nowhere else, and does nothing against an Ailment.

text.name: Burn
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Fire damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 4s. 26 damage a second, never scaled by Spell, Attack or Critical.

text.name: Burst
text.means: Damage in a circle. A Burst you carry goes off around YOU on a cooldown, 2.4 tiles across, for a figure off your character level that nothing but increased Damage moves. A Burst set off by a DEATH is a share of the hit that killed it, and sets off the Bursts of whatever IT kills, 8 deep. Bursts overlap freely.

text.name: Charge
text.means: What a flask holds. Each carries 2, a descent always begins full, and nothing about them survives one — there is nothing to hoard.

text.name: Chill
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Cold damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 3s. Each stack takes 6% off movement, attack and cast speed. 8 stacks FREEZE it for 1.4s and clear them, and the next hit on a body coming out of one is a Critical whatever your chance is.

text.name: Cloud
text.means: A circle on the ground that leaves an Ailment on everything standing in it. It has no target limit, so a wider Cloud is the whole of how it hits more.

text.name: Cone
text.means: A wedge in front of you. Everything standing in it takes the WHOLE hit and nothing takes a share, and there is no target limit — so how many bodies the wedge holds is the whole of what a use is worth. Opened past 360° it is every direction at once and what you are facing stops mattering.

text.name: Convert
text.means: The skill stops dealing its own damage type and deals another instead. Its OWN tree follows the change — a node reading the old type reads the new one, so no point you walked is stranded — and your gear does not, so a line on a ring keeps naming the type it named.

text.name: Critical
text.means: A Critical hit deals ×2 your damage, plus whatever Critical Damage you have found. Critical Chance is how often: every skill has its own, and increased Critical Chance scales THAT. A spell and an attack count it separately.

text.name: Curse
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Dark damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 8s. When the body dies it bursts for 4% of its maximum life per stack, 2.2 tiles across.

text.name: Dodge
text.means: A Dodged hit deals nothing at all, exactly as a Blocked one does, and does nothing against an Ailment either. It caps at 50% and is TRADED for Armour rather than worn beside it: what stops some hits outright no longer blunts the rest.

text.name: Echo
text.means: The swing landing again on the next enemy out from the one you struck, for 70% of it. The first looks 1.5 tiles from that enemy and each one after it looks 0.6 tiles further, so more Echoes reach deeper into a pack. Nothing is hit twice by one use.

text.name: Exposure
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Light damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 5s. Each stack is 4% increased damage taken, from anyone.

text.name: Fork
text.means: A bolt falls from above on an enemy near the one you hit — within 3.2 tiles of it — for 45% of the damage. It is its own bolt, not the shot carrying on, so where the shot came from decides nothing. Nothing is hit twice by one use.

text.name: Gust
text.means: What GALE holds. You move 10% faster for each one, anything that lands a hit takes one, and one comes back every 6s.

text.name: increased / reduced
text.means: Every increased line of one stat adds into one sum, and the sum multiplies the base once. Two 50% increased lines are 100%, not 125%. Reduced subtracts from the same sum.

text.name: more / less
text.means: Every more line multiplies on its own, on top of everything else. Two 50% more lines are 125% more, not 100%. Less divides the same way: 40% less is 0.6 times.

text.name: Pierce
text.means: A Projectile carries on through what it hits. Each Pierce catches one more enemy behind the target — up to 4.5 tiles further along the line and 0.85 tiles either side of it — for 70% of the damage.

text.name: Poison
text.means: Applied only by something that says it applies one, for 6s. 19 damage a second, never scaled by Spell, Attack or Critical.

text.name: Projectile
text.means: A skill throws one Projectile at what you aimed at. Each one beyond the first flies at another enemy within 3.5 tiles of that target, for full damage. Nothing is hit twice by one use.

text.name: Repeat
text.means: One more swing at the enemy you aimed at, in the same use and at full damage. Repeats stop the moment that enemy is down.

text.name: Resistance
text.means: Blunts one damage type, Ailments included. It caps at 75%, and Resistance and Armour multiply rather than adding — at both caps a hit lands for a sixteenth.

text.name: Shock
text.means: Applied by a hit dealing Lightning damage, at whatever chance you have bought, for 4s. 7 damage a second, and every tick throws 80% of it at up to 3 enemies within 2.4 tiles.

text.name: Slow
text.means: An enemy swings and casts more slowly for a duration. It is NOT a Burst — a Burst is damage in a circle and a Slow deals none, because every damage number in the game belongs to the skill in your main slot.

text.name: Splash
text.means: Damage in a circle around the body a hit landed on, for a share of that hit. Every skill that hits ONE enemy carries it without being asked, and its own card says the share and the reach.

text.name: Spread
text.means: How far a Projectile past the first looks for its own enemy, from the one you aimed at. 3.5 tiles bare.

text.name: Starved
text.means: With nothing left in the pool the use happens anyway and lands for 50% of your damage. Running dry is a price, never a wall.

text.name: Stun
text.means: An enemy neither swings nor closes for a duration. The chance is the share of its MAXIMUM life the one hit took, raised to the power 1.5 — 3% for a tenth of it, 72% for four fifths — and a hit that kills a body outright always Stuns it, so what a Stun sets off still fires on one you take down in a single blow.

text.name: Aftershock
text.description: Every Ailment on an enemy also deals 50% of each tick to enemies within 2.2 tiles of it, and your Ailments last 40% less time.
